name: Speculator
description:
Your time among the grain brokers of Ockham has taught you how to spot an opportunity for profit.

During Intermezzo, you may attempt to broker a trade deal. Spend any amount of Treasure to purchase goods. You may also take on debt up to the amount of Treasure you spend (for example, if you put 4 Treasure down, you may take on an additional 4 Treasure of debt to purchase 8 Treasure's-worth of goods). Describe the goods, how you purchase them and how you intend to sell them for a profit. If you take on debt, establish who you borrow from.

Roll Awe, Perform or Persuade against a difficulty of 10 plus the value of the goods, in Treasure. On a pass, you manage to sell the goods for twice what you paid for them. On a failure, the goods are damaged, lost or stolen, and your investment is lost. Either way, you still owe any debt you took on.

Describe how you buy and sell.
